subject: Publisher claim handshake + automation proposal for NimbusCloud offer
messages:
From: Emily Chen <emily.chen@nimbuscloud.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>
Cc: Raj Patel <raj.patel@nimbuscloud.com>
Date: Sun, 22 Aug 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Next steps for publisher claim + automation ask

Hi Jasmine / Connor,

Thanks again for the walkthrough earlier. We're ready to start the publisher claim for NimbusCloud's new "DataMesh Studio" offer but want to reduce manual handoffs — specifically around SPN provisioning, identity evidence, and the offer JSON updates.

Quick asks:
- Can Redwood share a minimal automation checklist or a script pattern to create the SPN and assign the exact RBAC roles your onboarding pipeline expects?
- We'll need a list of the exact artifact names you validate (manifest, offer JSON, logo assets, sku mapping) so our CI can produce a validated bundle.
- Do you accept DocuSign-signed co-sell forms or do we need to upload ID evidence to the portal?

Attaching a draft of our internal checklist — this is the first pass. Can we schedule a 30-minute sync to agree on the automation touchpoints?

Thanks,
Emily Chen
Head of Partnerships, NimbusCloud

Attachments: publisher_checklist_v2.xlsx
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>
To: Emily Chen <emily.chen@nimbuscloud.com>
Cc: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 23 Aug 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Next steps for publisher claim + automation ask

Hi Emily — great to hear you're ready to proceed. Short answers first: yes we can accept DocuSign for co-sell forms (legal will want the signature and a copy of the MPN/partner ID), and we have a small CLI template that automates SPN creation + role assignment.

I've attached a short how-to and the SPN expectations (azure-spn-setup.md). High-level workflow we recommend:
- CI pipeline produces validated offer bundle (offer-json-draft.json) + assets zip
- Trigger Redwood onboarding webhook to register the claim (we'll provide a one-time API key)
- Our validator returns a pass/fail and an artifact checksum you can embed in the pipeline

Proposed next steps:
1) Connor and I will run through your checklist on Tue Aug 24 at 11am PT — please confirm if that works for Raj.
2) If the checklist checks out, we'll hand you the onboarding webhook and a short terraform/az cli snippet to wire SPN + role assignment.
3) Legal: please route the co-sell form to Marissa (cc'ed) for signature verification.

Connor — can you prepare the validator quickstart and the webhook token? I'll bring the offer JSON sample.

Best,
Jasmine Liu
Partner Solutions Manager | Redwood Inference

Attachments: azure-spn-setup.md, offer-json-draft.json
From: Raj Patel <raj.patel@nimbuscloud.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>
Cc: Emily Chen <emily.chen@nimbuscloud.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 24 Aug 2027 08:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Next steps for publisher claim + automation ask

On Mon, Aug 23, 2027 at 10:05 AM Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Hi Emily — great to hear you're ready to proceed. Short answers first: yes we can accept DocuSign for co-sell forms (legal will want the signature and a copy of the MPN/partner ID), and we have a small CLI template that automates SPN creation + role assignment.
> 
> I've attached a short how-to and the SPN expectations (azure-spn-setup.md). High-level workflow we recommend:
> - CI pipeline produces validated offer bundle (offer-json-draft.json) + assets zip
> - Trigger Redwood onboarding webhook to register the claim (we'll provide a one-time API key)
> - Our validator returns a pass/fail and an artifact checksum you can embed in the pipeline

Thanks Jasmine — the plan looks good. Two quick questions before the sync:
1) For SPN roles, do you require Owner on the Subscription or just Contributor + User Access Administrator? We prefer least privilege.
2) Will the validator check SKU-level entitlements or just manifest/JSON schema?

If you can reply in-thread so we can capture the answers for our CI templates that would be helpful.

— Raj
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Emily Chen <emily.chen@nimbuscloud.com>, Raj Patel <raj.patel@nimbuscloud.com>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>
Cc: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 24 Aug 2027 12:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Next steps for publisher claim + automation ask

Emily / Raj — looping in legal & procurement note. Quick clarifications from our side so there are no surprises later: 
- DocuSign is fine for the co-sell MSA, but we need the partner's MPN ID and a PDF copy of the signed document uploaded to the HubSpot record (link: https://hubspot.redwood.ai/contacts/3429).
- SPN permissions: please use Contributor + User Access Administrator scoped to the subscription used for offer staging. We do not require Owner. Document the SPN client id/tenant in your artifact bundle but do not include secrets.
- Validator scope: it runs schema checks (manifest + offer JSON), asset hash validation, and SKU entitlement basic checks (mapping vs SKU metadata). It will not validate custom fulfillment endpoints beyond a light smoke test.

Operational asks: after your CI produces the bundle, ping the onboarding webhook and set a follow-up: we usually do a 24-48 hour review window for technical gate issues. If everything passes, onboarding team will proceed with publisher claim and set status in the publisher portal.

Marissa Cole
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>
To: Emily Chen <emily.chen@nimbuscloud.com>, Raj Patel <raj.patel@nimbuscloud.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 24 Aug 2027 21:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Next steps for publisher claim + automation ask

Thanks all — quick recap and action items: 
- NimbusCloud: update CI to produce the offer bundle (offer-json-draft.json) and attach the SPN metadata (client id + tenant). Do not check in secrets.
- NimbusCloud: sign and upload DocuSign co-sell form to the HubSpot record and share the signed PDF with Marissa.
- Redwood (Connor): create onboarding webhook token and share the token + validator quickstart by EOD Wed Aug 25.
- Sync: Tue Aug 24 11:00am PT confirmed — we'll run the checklist live and iterate on the automation snippet.

If anything changes before the sync, reply in-thread. Looking forward to getting DataMesh Studio onto the marketplace.

— Jasmine
Partner Solutions Manager | Redwood Inference
